message.content:
This is a lithium-ion battery module, so it falls in heading 8507. The relevant subheading is 8507.60 (lithium-ion accumulators). I recall CBP rulings on similar battery assemblies for headsets, which classified them under 8507.60.0010, the lithium-ion batteries of the type used as the primary source of power for electric vehicles. That one doesn't fit here. The other statistical suffix is 8507.60.0020, which covers other lithium-ion batteries. Within 8507.60.00, the statistical suffixes I recall are:

- 8507.60.0010: Lithium-ion batteries of a kind used as the primary source of electrical power of electrically powered vehicles of subheading 8703.40, 8703.50, 8703.60, 8703.70, 8703.80
- 8507.60.0020: Other, with a 2.7% duty rate

Before the 2022 revisions the structure was similar. The battery pack with a PCB and a single cell is still classified as an accumulator under 8507, not as a part of the headset, since it is a battery.
